location.address: Avenida de Montevideu, Porto (two points: near Castelo do Queijo, and Jardim do Homem do Leme)

leads.reason: Register entries (ICNF processos KNJ3/045 girth 3.85m age 77, and KNJ3/046 girth unrecorded age 50), both tipo 'Alameda' about 550m apart along Avenida de Montevideu. Not researched further this pass: unclear whether each is a genuine standalone collectible point or part of a longer roadside planting, and no independent source was checked. Worth a closer look, ideally with a site photo or streetview check.

Register entry (ICNF processo AIP131211131I) has a corrupted or implausible age field: age_register 16 but last_measured recorded as '45', which is not a valid year (register pitfall: a field holding something other than what its name says). A 4m girth on a 16-year-old magnolia is also physically implausible. Needs the ICNF source record checked directly to establish the real age before this can be verified, and needs an access check for a street-tree location on Rua de São Vicente.

location.address: Palácio do Freixo (Pestana Pousada), Estrada Nacional 108, Porto

leads.reason: Register entry (ICNF processo AIP13120359I, no age or measurements recorded). The palace is now a 5-star hotel/pousada, and 5.1km from the city centre, so both public access to the 10,000 sqm gardens for non-guests and the 30-minute transport-time rule need confirming before this can ship. Not researched further this pass for time.

location.address: Jardim do Palacete Burmester ('Casa dos Livros'), grounds of the Faculdade de Ciências, Universidade do Porto, Rua do Campo Alegre, Porto

leads.reason: Register entry (ICNF processo AIP13121886I, girth 3.4m, no age on file) and confirmed as one of four classified specimens at Palacete Burmester per https://ambiente.cm-porto.pt/destaque/porto-tem-mais-21-arvores-de-interesse-publico. Held back only because Porto already publishes a Himalayan Cedar (por_008, The Himalayan Cedar of the Palácio de Cristal) and this pass capped the Palacete Burmester additions at two (por_016 horse chestnut, por_017 yew) to avoid crowding the page with a second same-species entry; not a quality failure. Ready to verify and add if a future pass wants a fuller Palacete Burmester cluster.

location.address: Jardim do Palacete Burmester ('Casa dos Livros'), grounds of the Faculdade de Ciências, Universidade do Porto, Rua do Campo Alegre, Porto

leads.reason: Register entry (ICNF processo AIP13121887I, girth 4.9m, no age on file), confirmed via the same municipal article as the Palacete Burmester quartet. Held back because this pass already delivers two other tulip trees for Porto (por_001 Casa Tait, por_014 Quinta Primo Madeira) and capped Palacete Burmester at two additions; genuinely a different individual, not a duplicate. Good candidate for a future depth pass.

location.address: Escola Municipal João de Deus, R. João de Deus, 399, Porto

blocked.reason: Register entry (ICNF processo KNJ1/009, girth 8.8m, age recorded 300 at last measurement 2006, one of Porto's oldest classified trees) stands in the yard of an operating municipal primary school. No source found confirming public visiting access to a working school's grounds, and none is expected. Blocked under hard rule 10. This is NOT the same tree as the Casa Allen tulipeiro (por_020, different processo, different address); do not confuse the two.

location.address: Jardim da Secção Regional Norte, Ordem dos Médicos, Rua Delfim Maia, Porto

blocked.reason: Register entries (ICNF processos KNJ1/612 tulipeiro girth 4.3m age 100, and KNJ1/611 cedro-do-atlas girth 3.4m age 100, both classified 2011) stand in the private garden of the medical association's regional headquarters. The Ordem's Centro de Cultura e Congressos next door hosts public cultural events, but no source found confirms the garden itself, as opposed to the event spaces, is open for casual visits. Same shape of problem as the already-blocked CCDR-N camphor tree below; left out per hard rule 10 until public garden access is confirmed.

Register entry (ICNF processo KNJ3/047, tipo 'Conjunto arbóreo') covers roughly three dozen Norfolk Araucaria specimens scattered through the 41,000 sqm Jardim do Passeio Alegre. Not a collectible point: there is no single obvious place to stand, unlike the compact Alameda dos Plátanos (por_026) or the seven fan palms (por_024) in the same city. Fails the ensemble test the way Barcelona's La Rambla plane trees did.

Register entry (ICNF processo KNJ3/048, tipo 'Alameda') covers 63 Canary palm specimens across the same 41,000 sqm garden as the Norfolk araucaria set above. Same failure: an avenue spread across a large park rather than one destination. Blocked for the same reason, not for lack of remarkableness.

location.address: CCDR-N headquarters garden, Rua Rainha D. Estefânia nº251, Porto

blocked.reason: Register entry (ICNF processo AIP13121884I, girth 5.75m, no age on file) well sourced independently (ambiente.cm-porto.pt, viva-porto.pt, JN, and ccdr-n.pt itself all cover the classification), but the tree stands on the private grounds of a regional government headquarters (Comissão de Coordenação e Desenvolvimento Regional do Norte). No source confirms genuine public access to the garden itself; the only access detail found was the agency's office hours (business days 14:00-18:00), which govern administrative business, not visiting a tree. Per hard rule 10, left out rather than assumed open. Worth re-checking if CCDR-N is confirmed to allow casual garden access.
